s4.champion: Hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer

raw.champion: Hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer
raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of a large pelvic mass, primary infertility, and bilateral breast nodules, combined with the histopathological findings of a spindle cell tumor and the detection of a pathogenic variant in the FH gene, are consistent with Hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer (HLRCC). The genetic testing result is particularly supportive of this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyoma
rejected.why: While the patient has a large pelvic mass, the mass is described as extending from the right adnexa to the left and is suggestive of an ovarian primary, rather than a uterine origin.

rejected.label: Ovarian leiomyoma
rejected.why: Although the mass is ovarian in origin, the presence of a pathogenic variant in the FH gene and the patient's other symptoms suggest a more complex syndrome, such as HLRCC, rather than a solitary ovarian leiomyoma.

rejected.label: Intravenous leiomyomatosis
rejected.why: There is no mention of the mass extending into the vascular system, which is a characteristic feature of intravenous leiomyomatosis.

rejected.label: Sclerosing stromal tumor of the ovary
rejected.why: The histopathological findings do not match those typically seen in sclerosing stromal tumors, which are usually characterized by a pseudolobular pattern and a prominent stromal component.
